messages:
Jules: Heads-up — Northbridge pre-renewal cost sprint kickoff. Mini-QBR in 10 days. Need: current spend trend, token econ breakdown, onboarding blockers, budget alerts, and ops playbook. Who can grab forecast?

Samir: I can run a 30/60/90 forecast from usage logs. Will need last 90 days + projected embed growth. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Priya: I'll compile token economics with per-feature cost. Quick ask: do we include deduped prompts in model cache? That changes tokens by ~8%.

Lila: Saw a spike last week from an automated test suite — billing flagged it. I can pull the billing delta and set a temporary budget alert.

Jules: Good — Samir + Lila please sync on the spike root cause. Priya, include two scenarios (conservative, aggressive).

OpsBot: alert: northbridge-prod test-run caused 120k extra tokens on 2026-03-18 03:40 UTC — tag #billing-spikes

Samir: Sync notes: spike came from nightly e2e that hit embeddings API 15x. Proposed fix: rate-limit test env and add a webhook to drop prober traffic.

Priya: Drafted token econ table (link): https://redwood.internal/for/northbridge/token-econ-draft — comments? Will add cost per 1k tokens + per-embed.

Jules: Action items: 1) Samir: forecast + mitigation (EOD tmw). 2) Lila: billing delta + set alert (today). 3) Priya: token econ scenarios + top 3 cost levers (48h). 4) Ops: add guardrail to test env (ASAP). Add any risks to renewal note.

Samir: noted. I'll ping infra for rate-limit rule and post the CIDR updates here when done. :thumbsup:
